q: A particle with rest mass m₀ moves at 0.80c. What is its total energy in terms of m₀c²?

A solid sphere (I = 2/5 MR²) rolls without slipping down an incline. What is acceleration if g = 9.8 and sinθ = 0.50?

In a LCR series circuit, L = 0.10 H, C = 10 μF. What is resonant frequency?
Light of wavelength 600 nm in air falls on a thin film (n = 1.38) at normal incidence. What is minimum thickness for constructive reflection?
explain: 2nt = λ/2 for first constructive, t = λ/(4n) = 600/(5.52) = 109 nm.

q: An electron accelerated through 100 V has de Broglie wavelength?
A uniform rod of length 2.0 m, mass 6.0 kg pivoted at one end, released from horizontal. What is angular acceleration at release?
explain: τ = mg(L/2), I = 1/3 ML², α = τ/I = 3g/(2L) = 7.35 rad/s².

A photon of wavelength 0.020 nm undergoes Compton scattering at 90°. What is shift Δλ?
A 2.0 kg mass on a spring k = 80 N/m has damping, amplitude halves in 10 s. What is Q factor approx?
explain: A = A₀e^(-bt/2m), b from halving, Q = ω₀m/b ≈ 31.

q: A projectile is launched at 45° with speed 20 m/s from height 0. What is range including air resistance neglected?
A car of mass 1000 kg takes a banked curve radius 100 m, banking 30°, no friction. What speed for no side slip?
A disc of moment of inertia I rotates at ω, then a mass m drops onto rim, radius R. What is new ω?
explain: Angular momentum conserved, I_f = I + mR².

q: A wire of length 2.0 m, resistance 4.0 Ω is bent into a circle in a B field changing at 0.10 T/s. What is induced emf?
explain: Area = L²/4π = 0.318 m², emf = A dB/dt = 0.0318 V.

q: A 0.50 m long pipe closed at one end has fundamental frequency 170 Hz. What is speed of sound?
explain: Closed pipe λ = 4L = 2.0 m, v = fλ = 340 m/s.
